usage.callShape: POST https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/smart-money/holdings with JSON body {chains:["ethereum"]} (chains is a TOP-LEVEL field, a list of chain names)
usage.outputShape: body[] smart-money holdings rows (per-token holdings: token symbol/address, chain, holders, balance/value, smart-money flow metrics). Exact field names unconfirmed — both paid attempts 422'd on body shape before reaching a 200.
quirks: REQUIRED top-level 'chains' field — must be a LIST of chain names, e.g. ["ethereum", "solana"]. Omitting it (or nesting it under 'parameters') returns 422: "Required field 'body -> chains' is missing".
Do NOT nest under a 'parameters' wrapper — fields go at the body root (flat), matching the sibling verified Nansen endpoint /profiler/address/pnl-summary which uses flat top-level fields.
Singular 'chain' is rejected; must be plural 'chains' as an array.
txHash returned null but payment confirmed; x402 pay-per-call, charged across both Base and Solana networks.
Charged $0.05 even on 422 validation errors (x402 settles before body validation) — get the body shape right on the first paid call.
Likely additional required/optional fields (pagination, date range) beyond chains — flat-body confirmation run needed to capture the real 200 output shape.
usage.guide: Call POST https://api.nansen.ai/api/v1/smart-money/holdings with a flat JSON body containing a top-level "chains" array of chain names, e.g. {"chains":["ethereum"]}. Do not wrap fields in a "parameters" object and do not use singular "chain" — both yield a 422 "body -> chains is missing". Pay ~$0.05 USDC via x402 (no API key); note you are charged even on validation errors, so send the correct shape first. Read the returned smart-money holdings rows from the JSON body array. The exact 200 output field names are unconfirmed (both QA attempts 422'd on body nesting) — a flat-body confirmation run is needed.
